annotations.title: Get Company Open Job Count & Hiring Breakdown

description: Get real-time open job count, department/country/remote/seniority headcount breakdowns, salary disclosure count, and 24h/7d/30d hiring velocity growth for any company slug, domain, LinkedIn company URL, or ATS board URL (1 Credit when open_jobs > 0; 0 Credits when open_jobs = 0).

linkedin_url.description: Optional LinkedIn company URL or ID (e.g. "https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe/")

refresh.description: Set to true to trigger a live ETag check against Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby

slug.description: Company slug, domain, LinkedIn URL, or ATS URL (e.g. "stripe", "stripe.com", "https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe/", "https://boards.greenhouse.io/stripe")

name: get_company_job_count
